definition: Conversica is a US-based cloud software technology company, headquartered in San Mateo, California, that provides two-way AI-driven conversational software and a suite of Intelligent Virtual Assistants for businesses to engage customers via email, chat, and SMS..
details: Conversica is a US-based cloud software technology company, headquartered in San Mateo, California, that provides two-way AI-driven conversational software and a suite of Intelligent Virtual Assistants for businesses to engage customers via email, chat, and SMS.

explainer.lead: Conversica is a US cloud software company whose virtual assistants hold two-way conversations with business customers. Its software works across email, chat, and SMS, supporting customer engagement beyond one-way messaging.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a helper at a company’s front desk who can write to customers and answer when they reply. Conversica makes computer helpers that do this through email, chat, and text messages. The important part is that the conversation goes both ways.
tiers.practitioner: An engineer would treat Conversica as a cloud service providing intelligent virtual assistants for customer conversations over email, chat, and SMS. A useful evaluation checks complete two-way exchanges on each channel, not just whether an initial message can be sent.
tiers.paperLevel: Let K = {email, chat, SMS}; Conversica provides cloud-hosted virtual assistants that support exchanges m1, r1, m2, r2, ... between a business and its customers over those channels. This is a system-level description of conversational software, not a specification of an underlying model, training method, or benchmark.
